description: This source file defines the TransactionAgentStatistics class which implements the ITransactionAgentStatistics interface. It tracks transaction metrics such as started, succeeded, failed, and throttled transactions using counters and provides methods to update these metrics and create copies of the statistics object.

classes.name: TransactionAgentStatistics
classes.description: Implements transaction metric tracking for the Orleans transaction agent, including counters for started, successful, failed, and throttled transactions.

methods.name: TransactionAgentStatistics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes counters for tracking transaction metrics.

methods.name: TrackTransactionStarted
methods.description: Increment the count of started transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionSucceeded
methods.description: Increment the count of successful transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionFailed
methods.description: Increment the count of failed transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionThrottled
methods.description: Increment the count of throttled transactions.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing ITransactionAgentStatistics instance.
